stem: Which proposed treatment for a 15-year-old is most likely to require special medical treatment consideration?

options.text: A standard short course of oral antibiotics
A plaster cast for a fracture

explanation: An experimental procedure is the correct answer because it is an example of special medical treatment for a person under 16 years old and may require a different consent pathway from routine care.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because a standard short course of oral antibiotics is routine treatment and is not singled out as special medical treatment.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a routine appendicectomy is ordinary clinical care and is not identified here as special medical treatment.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because an experimental procedure is specifically listed as special medical treatment for those under 16 years old.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a plaster cast for a fracture is routine management and not an example of special medical treatment.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a standard asthma preventer is routine treatment and does not fall under the special medical treatment examples.
